execution_contract.raw_capture: Use subprocess argv arrays with shell=False and exact finite env. Exclusive binary stdout/stderr files preserve NULs, filenames and real streams. Save actual numeric exit, elapsed time, exact argv/cwd/env, byte counts/SHA, timeout/truncation flags, cleanup/reaped status. Process-create errors have null numeric exit. Store actual outer tool object before display; missing independent outer streams stay null, child streams remain their real files.
execution_contract.caps: Each Git command <=60s, bounded terminate/reap <=10s; whole driver <=240s. Each stdout <=32 MiB, each stderr <=2 MiB, <=100000 status/ref/worktree records. On cap overflow preserve captured partial bytes, mark incomplete and STOP without replay. Never silently drop entries or accept a partial inventory.
execution_contract.presentation: Driver stdout <=6000 UTF8 bytes, only actual report paths/pins/counts/status and <=10 safely escaped sample names, never full Git raw or config. Save the full parsed path inventory to census.json. Bound output BEFORE printing. Do not JSON.parse rendered tool output or Warning prefixes.
execution_contract.parsing: Parse C1 porcelain-v2 NUL records using the actual record-type grammar, including rename/copy two-path records and branch headers; never whitespace-split filenames. C2 is fixed NUL fields per newline-terminated record; keep explicit empty upstream and cached-gone states. C3 porcelain -z fields retain detached/bare/locked/prunable flags. Preserve raw bytes and represent non-UTF8 path bytes reversibly (base64 plus escaped display). Unknown record shape STOP; no guessed mandatory keys.
execution_contract.consistency: After C3 hash main HEAD/ref/index again without Git. Require no driver-caused index/ref mutation and compare before/after observation; a concurrent change makes the census non-atomic/incomplete, never repair it. Compare C1 branch.oid/branch.head with matching C2 branch and C3 main-worktree HEAD when applicable. Unborn/detached/missing cached upstream are explicit observed states, not fabricated refs or automatic network requests.
execution_contract.semantic_limits: Local refs/remotes are cached. C2 upstream relation does not verify live remote identity. A changed path cannot be attributed to a user or this task from status alone: classify UNATTRIBUTED unless matched to an actual immutable accepted provenance record. Proposed classifications and directory summaries are not authorization to stage/delete/copy anything.
execution_contract.failure: Preserve original exact driver/source/argv, actual outputs and partial results under this new round. No retry, fallback Git invocation or environment adjustment. New unexpected issue requires genuine Astra plan.

census_schema.repository: actual root/gitdir/index before+after, HEAD/branch and cached upstream or explicit absent
census_schema.worktrees: registered path/HEAD/branch flags only, no cleanliness claim for other checkouts
census_schema.tracked_changes: exact porcelain records with separate index/worktree status and reversible original path bytes
census_schema.untracked: directory summaries/files exactly as C1 returns; recursive_complete=false
census_schema.attribution: UNATTRIBUTED by default; optional verified provenance references cannot change Git paths
census_schema.findings: actual unexpected shape, cap, concurrent mutation or identity inconsistency; never hide failed raw
